podcast.body: This single was released early in Faith No More's career, featuring singer Chuck Mosley. Its unique sound, characterized by crunchy metallic guitars, heavy beats, and a rap-style vocal delivery, stood out significantly in 1985, as nobody else was doing that kind of music at the time. "Early Faith No More featuring singer Chuck Mosley and We Care A Lot."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song was featured on Faith No More's first two albums, _We Care A Lot_ (1985) and _Introduce Yourself_ (1987), during Chuck Mosley's tenure as lead singer. "There's Faith No More from 1987 with We Care A Lot featuring singer Chuck Mosley."
